services.name: AWS Lambda
services.billing: Request count, configured memory/CPU and execution duration; dependent services billed separately
services.runtimes: Python, Node.js, Java, .NET, Ruby, custom runtimes
services.goodFor: Event-driven functions, S3/EventBridge processing, lightweight APIs and asynchronous jobs
services.watchFor: Cold starts, execution limits, event-source charges, networking and downstream services

services.name: Azure Functions Consumption
services.freeQuota: 1M executions + 400,000 GB-seconds/month on eligible Consumption usage
services.billing: Executions and observed memory-duration; storage/networking are separate
services.packaging: Code deployment or container depending on hosting model
services.runtimes: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET, Java, PowerShell and custom handlers
services.goodFor: Event Grid/Service Bus triggers, APIs, scheduled Python jobs and Azure-native automation
services.watchFor: Storage account costs, hosting-plan differences and cold-start behavior

services.name: Google Cloud Run
services.freeQuota: 180,000 vCPU-seconds + 360,000 GiB-seconds + 2M requests/month for request-based services
services.billing: CPU, memory and requests while instances are billable; pricing depends on region/billing mode
services.runtimes: Any language/binary that runs in a container; source builds support common runtimes
services.goodFor: FastAPI, containerized APIs, web services, batch jobs and portable serverless containers
services.watchFor: Minimum instances, egress, build/registry costs and regional pricing

services.name: Cloudflare Workers
services.freeQuota: 100,000 requests/day on Workers Free; 10 ms CPU/invocation for standard free requests
services.billing: Request and CPU-time model; static assets have separate included behavior
services.runtimes: JavaScript/TypeScript/Wasm ecosystem; Python support depends on Workers runtime capabilities
services.goodFor: Edge APIs, middleware, auth, routing, webhooks and very lightweight global compute
services.watchFor: CPU-time limits make heavy analytics or conventional container workloads a poor fit

services.name: Azure Container Apps Consumption
services.billing: Consumption of active/idle replicas plus requests; ancillary Azure services are separate
services.goodFor: FastAPI, workers, microservices and jobs that need more container semantics than Functions
services.watchFor: Container registry, networking, logs and storage can be separately billable
